compensating.why: hop 3 never reports a pair start
odd hop 3 counts any surrogate as a pair start

ownership_reason: Only the membership test sees both units of a surrogate pair; the facade, the pair-start predicate and the plumbing hops pass the position along and cannot repair a membership verdict with a one-line change. indexOfAny and the CharSequence overload of indexOfAnyBut compare the second unit explicitly, the supplementary-character tests expect it, and containsOnly (BMP tests) relies on the same membership test.
